satellite.title: Vegetation Health Monitoring
satellite.subtitle: Monitor crop health using satellite NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) data
satellite.recVeryHealthy: Vegetation is thriving. Maintain current practices. Monitor for pest infestations as dense canopy can harbor pests.
satellite.recHealthy: Good vegetation health. Continue regular irrigation and nutrient management. Consider foliar spray for further improvement.
satellite.recModerate: Vegetation shows moderate stress. Check for water deficiency, nutrient imbalance, or early pest attack. Increase irrigation frequency.
satellite.recSparse: Vegetation is under significant stress. Immediate action needed: check soil moisture, apply emergency irrigation, test soil nutrients, and scout for pest/disease.

yield.title: Crop Yield Prediction
yield.subtitle: Predict your crop yield using soil, weather, and regional data analysis
yield.tipSoilDesc: Regular soil testing and balanced fertilizer application can improve yield by 15-20%.
yield.tipIrrigationDesc: Drip and sprinkler irrigation can save water by 40-60% and boost yield significantly.
yield.tipSeedDesc: Use certified high-yielding variety seeds from authorized dealers for best results.
yield.tipSeasonDesc: Sowing at the right time as per your region's agricultural calendar maximizes yield.
